title: celmisia saxifraga
intro: Celmisia saxifraga, commonly known as Mountain Daisies, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and soothing digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Celmisia saxifraga are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to ease congestion and alleviate coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
